note: Numbered choices that a figure draws as graphics rather than text. They are absent from the PDF text layer, so the extractor cannot read them and refuses to guess; each entry below was read from the page rendered at 150 DPI and records only what the page prints. No stem, option or answer key is supplied here — only which numerals the figure offers as choices. Questions whose answer key the source prints only as a figure (20, 23), whose answer is a pair of decimals the written-answer format cannot carry (45), or whose diagram cannot be recovered whole (16, 29, 41, 47) are deliberately NOT curated: they stay omitted with their reasons.
